messages.subject: x axis in the wrong order
parts:
Hi ggplot2 mailing list,

I'm having a slight bit of trouble producing the correct graph. I'm counting mentions of candidates for the London Mayoral Election on Twitter and now that I've got a few days data I thought it would be a good idea to do a line graph to view changes over time .

The problem is I can't get the Days on the X axis to go in the right order. I've tried calling them different things eg Days of the week but they go in alphabetical order rather than in time series. I've tried dates but as you can see below that isn't in the right order.

ggplot(data=week, aes(x=Day, y=Volume, group=Candidate, colour=Candidate)) + geom_line(size=1) + geom_point(size=4)

is the basic code I've been using and I've tried to define day as a factor but that doesn't seem to work either. Here's what I've produced so far but it should start with the 8th and 9th rather than end with them. My data in the spreadsheet goes from the 8th to the 14th in the correct order. Many thanks in advance for any assistance you are able to render.



http://venturesindatascience.blogspot.co.uk/

> counting mentions of candidates for the London Mayoral Election on
> Twitter and now that I've got a few days data I thought it would be a
> good idea to do a line graph to view changes over time .
>
> The problem is I can't get the Days on the X axis to go in the right
> order. I've tried calling them different things eg Days of the week but
> they go in alphabetical order rather than in time series. I've tried
> dates but as you can see below that isn't in the right order.
>
> ggplot(data=week, aes(x=Day, y=Volume, group=Candidate, colour=Candidate)) + geom_line(size=1) + geom_point(size=4)

You need the factor to be ordered correctly: right now it is in
lexical rather than numerical order.

Something like:

dayvals <- unique(week$Day)
dayvals <- dayvals[order(as.numeric(gsub("th","",daysvals)))]
week$Day <- factor(week$Day,levels=dayvals)

Or if the labels aren't important to you, you could just say

week$Day <- as.numeric(gsub("th","",as.character(week$Day)))
